findings.text: The tree entry helpers classify special internal values. One helper converts a sibling link to its offset form through the internal encoding helper. Another reports sibling links only when multi-index support is enabled and the value lies below the sibling upper bound. A retry sentinel marks entries that require a restart, with a predicate for exact equality and a broader predicate that treats any internal value at or below that sentinel as advanced. This lets callers distinguish ordinary entries from sibling redirections and transient retry states.

The retry marker is defined as an internal encoding of the value 256 [CITED]. Callers compare entries for equality against this marker to detect retry, and treat values at or below it as advanced states when also internal.

The cursor structure begins with a member named xa pointing to the owning array. Next a member named xa_index holds the current position. Then members named xa_shift and xa_sibs record shift and sibling span, followed by a member named xa_offset for the slot and a member named xa_pad present only to improve generated code. Later members named xa_node and xa_alloc hold the current node and a spare node. Finally a member named xa_update holds a node callback and a member named xa_lru holds a cache pointer. The callback type named xa_update_node_t accepts a node pointer and returns nothing.

The symbol XA_ERROR folds a code by shifting left by 2 [CITED] and adding 2 [CITED] to set low marker bits. The symbol XAS_BOUNDS is pointer value 1 [CITED]. The symbol XAS_RESTART is pointer value 3 [CITED]. The initializer named __XA_STATE sets the node field to the restart sentinel with cleared offset and padding and null allocation, update and cache fields.

The macro named XA_STATE creates a cursor from a name plus array and index with cleared shift and sibling span. The macro named XA_STATE_ORDER additionally accepts an order, aligns the index down to that order, derives shift rounded to chunk granularity and derives sibling coverage for the remainder. Both rely on a shared initializer that enters the restart state with cleared housekeeping fields.

Cursor locking is a thin delegation to the owning array lock family. Try, plain, bottom-half and interrupt variants for acquire and release, including a flags-saving interrupt form, all forward to the corresponding array operation on the cursor array field. A separate mark query forwards to the array marked check for a given mark.

Cursor health is encoded in low pointer bits and nullness. The symbol xas_invalid reports invalid when masked by 3 [CITED] non-zero. The symbol xas_valid negates that result. The symbol xas_is_node additionally requires non-null. The symbol xas_not_node applies the same low-bit or null test to a bare node pointer. The symbol xas_frozen tests for 2 [CITED]. The symbol xas_top treats values at or below the restart sentinel as the top of the walk. The symbol xas_error extracts a numeric code from the node field while the symbol xas_set_err installs a code there.

The cursor moves through restart, positioned and error states. Reset returns to restart without changing the index. Setting assigns a new index and forces restart. Advancing keeps the node but moves index and offset consistently with current depth, using zero depth when not on a node. Ordered setting aligns the index and derives shift and sibling span when multi support is present, otherwise it asserts zero order and behaves like plain setting. Retry handling treats a zero entry as needing retry, ignores non-retry entries, and otherwise resets to restart and reports retry. Reload fetches the current slot, resolving sibling redirection when multi support is present. Two setters install the node-update callback and the cache pointer.

Fast iteration stays within the current chunk when possible and otherwise delegates to slower find helpers. Next entry advances within the leaf while entries are present and ordinary, bailing to a general find on bounds, chunk edges, internal values or node mismatch. Marked iteration first locates the next set bit in the current node mark bitmap, with an optional advance, handling full-word and generic bitmap sizes, then validates bounds and presence before returning or delegating. Previous and next step by one slot within the leaf or delegate on edges and non-leaf states. Three loop macros provide plain, marked and conflict iteration by repeatedly invoking the corresponding find and step helpers.

When multi-index support is absent, order and split helpers become neutral. Order queries report 0 [CITED]. Splitting stores directly. Allocation and try variants do nothing. The minimum-order helper reports 0 [CITED].
The enumeration member named XA_CHECK_SCHED denotes 4096 [CITED] as a scheduling check threshold.

The streaming hash state begins with a member named total_len for accumulated length. Next members named v1 and v2 plus companions v3 and v4 hold running accumulators. Then a member named mem64 holds 4 [CITED] buffered words. Finally a member named memsize records buffered size.

The portable hash entry checks whether the word size equals 64 [CITED]. On wide machines it forwards to the wide variant, otherwise to the narrow variant, passing input, length and seed and returning an unsigned long.

The compression stream structure tracks input and output progress with paired pointers, available counts and totals. It carries a member named next_in for the next input byte with companions named avail_in and total_in for available and total input. Output uses members named next_out and avail_out with total named total_out. Diagnostics use a member named msg. A member named state points to opaque internal state while a member named workspace holds stream memory. Hints and integrity use members named data_type and adler with a member named reserved for future use. Aliases named z_stream and z_streamp denote the structure and its pointer. A separate minimal internal_state placeholder exists for compiler compatibility.

The symbol Z_NO_FLUSH denotes 0 [CITED]. The symbol Z_PARTIAL_FLUSH denotes 1 [CITED] and is deprecated in favor of sync flush. The symbol Z_PACKET_FLUSH denotes 2 [CITED]. The symbol Z_SYNC_FLUSH denotes 3 [CITED]. The symbol Z_FULL_FLUSH denotes 4 [CITED]. The symbol Z_FINISH denotes 5 [CITED]. The symbol Z_BLOCK denotes 6 [CITED] for inflate only.

The symbol Z_OK denotes 0 [CITED]. The symbol Z_STREAM_END denotes 1 [CITED]. The symbol Z_NEED_DICT denotes 2 [CITED]. The symbol Z_ERRNO denotes -1 [CITED]. The symbol Z_STREAM_ERROR denotes -2 [CITED]. The symbol Z_DATA_ERROR denotes -3 [CITED]. The symbol Z_MEM_ERROR denotes -4 [CITED]. The symbol Z_BUF_ERROR denotes -5 [CITED]. The symbol Z_VERSION_ERROR denotes -6 [CITED].

The symbol Z_NO_COMPRESSION denotes 0 [CITED]. The symbol Z_BEST_SPEED denotes 1 [CITED]. The symbol Z_BEST_COMPRESSION denotes 9 [CITED]. The symbol Z_DEFAULT_COMPRESSION denotes -1 [CITED]. The symbol Z_FILTERED denotes 1 [CITED]. The symbol Z_HUFFMAN_ONLY denotes 2 [CITED]. The symbol Z_DEFAULT_STRATEGY denotes 0 [CITED]. The symbol Z_BINARY denotes 0 [CITED]. The symbol Z_ASCII denotes 1 [CITED]. The symbol Z_UNKNOWN denotes 2 [CITED]. The symbol Z_DEFLATED denotes 8 [CITED] as the compression method.

The helper named deflateBound estimates worst-case compressed size from input length with small fractional overhead plus a constant margin. The macro named zlib_deflateInit initializes deflation by forwarding to a detailed initializer with preset method, window, memory and strategy choices. The macro named zlib_inflateInit initializes inflation by forwarding with a preset window choice.

Argument splitting duplicates the input string up to an allocation limit, counts whitespace-separated words, allocates a pointer vector with room for a hidden header slot plus terminator, then splits in place by writing terminators over whitespace and recording word starts. It optionally reports the count and returns the vector past the header on success or null on allocation failure. Freeing steps back to the header to release the duplicated string and then the vector.

The helper named __ashldi3 provides left logical shift over a double word. The helper named __ashrdi3 provides right arithmetic shift. Zero shift returns input unchanged. Smaller shifts combine halves with carries. Larger shifts relocate one half and fill with zeros for left or sign extension for right.

A length table maps each decoder operation to its encoded size as one base unit plus optional tag, jump and action bytes. Match variants occupy two units, with an extra unit when an action or jump is present. Any-form matches occupy one unit, plus one when an action is present. Conditional forms follow the same pattern. Terminal and control operations occupy one unit, with sequence or set closing operations adding a unit when they carry data or actions.

A scanner walks nested encodings to measure indefinite-length content, tracking nesting depth, validating tags and lengths, rejecting overruns and primitive indefinite forms, and reporting the total consumed span or an error message. The main decoder interprets a compact operation stream with program and data cursors, small fixed stacks for nested constructed contexts and jumps, plus flags for indefinite length, match state and constructed expectation. It matches tags with conditional and skip variants, decodes short, long and indefinite lengths with bounds checks, pushes constructed scopes, invokes per-operation actions on leaves, and returns action errors or size violations directly.

The symbol NR_CONS_STACK denotes 10 [CITED] as the constructed-context depth limit. The symbol NR_JUMP_STACK denotes 10 [CITED] as the jump depth limit. Inputs longer than 65535 [CITED] are rejected with a message-size error. Flag values use 1 [CITED] for indefinite length, 2 [CITED] for matched, 4 [CITED] for last matched and 32 [CITED] for constructed expectation. Long tags, excessive length octets, overruns, missing terminators and primitive indefinite uses all fail with diagnostic messages.

Splitting returns null when duplication or vector allocation fails, leaving no partial state to free. The freeing helper assumes the header convention and must only be called on successfully split vectors. In the unxz context the name kfree aliases a different deallocator, so callers must not assume the general slab semantics there.
Two headers use include guards. The symbol XXHASH_H marks the xxhash header as included. The symbol _ZLIB_H marks the zlib header as included.
